phrases.text: The Hour has drawn near and the moon was split ˹in two˺
phrases.head:
The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ (54:1)
("The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split asunder") (54:1).

phrases.text: Yet, whenever they see a sign, they turn away, saying, “Same old magic!”
They rejected ˹the truth˺ and followed their own desires
phrases.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ
phrases.head: Explanation of the saying of the Exalted: وَكَذَّبُوا وَاتَّبَعُوا أَهْوَاءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُسْتَقِرٌّ ("And they denied and followed their desires, and every matter is settled") (3)

phrases.text: and every matter will be settled
even though the stories ˹of destroyed nations˺ that have already come to them are a sufficient deterrent
˹This Quran is˺ profound ˹in˺ wisdom,
but warnings are of no benefit ˹to them˺
So turn away from them ˹O Prophet˺. ˹And wait for˺ the Day ˹when˺ the caller will summon ˹them˺ for something horrifying
phrases.head: The explanation of His saying — exalted is His mention: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُو الدَّاعِي إِلَى شَيْءٍ نُكُرٍ ("So turn away from them on the Day when the caller calls to something terrible") (54:6).

phrases.text: With eyes downcast, they will come forth from the graves as if they were swarming locusts
phrases.head: The explanation of the word of the Exalted: With downcast eyes they shall come forth from the graves as if they were scattered locusts (7).

phrases.text: rushing towards the caller.
The disbelievers will cry, “This is a difficult Day!”
Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺ and rejected Our servant, calling ˹him˺ insane.
phrases.head: The explanation of the word of the Exalted: Before them the people of Nūḥ denied; they denied Our servant and said: one possessed, and he was driven away (9).

phrases.text: And he was intimidated
So he cried out to his Lord, “I am helpless,
so help ˹me˺!”
So We opened the gates of the sky with pouring rain
phrases.head: The explanation of His — exalted is His mention — word: فَفَتَحْنَا أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ ("So We opened the gates of heaven with water pouring down") (54:11).

phrases.text: and caused the earth to burst with springs,
so the waters met for a fate already set
We carried him on that ˹Ark made˺ of planks and nails
phrases.head: The explanation of His — exalted is His mention — word: وَحَمَلْنَاهُ عَلَى ذَاتِ أَلْوَاحٍ وَدُسُرٍ ("And We carried him on a vessel of planks and nails") (54:13).

phrases.text: sailing under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes
a ˹fair˺ punishment on behalf of the one ˹they˺ denied
We certainly left this as a sign.
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His statement, the Exalted: wa-laqad taraknāhā āyatan fa-hal min muddakir (15) ("And indeed, We left it as a sign; is there then anyone who will be admonished?")

phrases.text: So is there anyone who will be mindful
Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember.
So is there anyone who will be mindful
’Ȃd ˹also˺ rejected ˹the truth˺.
Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
phrases.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ
phrases.head: Explanation of the word of the Exalted: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِي وَنُذُرِ ("ʿĀd denied; how then was My punishment and My warnings?") (18)

phrases.text: Indeed, We sent against them a furious wind, on a day of unrelenting misery
that snatched people up, leaving them like trunks of uprooted palm trees
Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember.
So is there anyone who will be mindful
Thamûd rejected the warnings ˹as well˺
arguing, “How can we follow one ˹average˺ human being from among us?
We would then truly be misguided and insane
Has the revelation been sent down ˹only˺ to him out of ˹all of˺ us?
In fact, he is a boastful liar.”
˹It was revealed to Ṣâliḥ,˺ “They will soon know who the boastful liar is
We are sending the she-camel as a test for them.
So watch them ˹closely˺,
and have patience
And tell them that the ˹drinking˺ water must be divided between them ˹and her˺, each taking a turn to drink ˹every other day˺.”
phrases.head: The explanation of the words of the Exalted: "And inform them that the water is to be divided between them; each drinking will be attended" (54:28)

phrases.text: But they roused a companion of theirs,
phrases.head: The statement concerning the explanation of His statement, the Exalted: fa-nādaw ṣāḥibahum fa-taʿāṭā fa-ʿaqar (29) ("Then they called their companion, and he seized [her] and hamstrung [her]")

phrases.text: so he dared to kill ˹her˺
Then how ˹dreadful˺ were My punishment and warnings
Indeed, We sent against them ˹only˺ one ˹mighty˺ blast, leaving them like the twigs of fence-builders
And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember.
So is there anyone who will be mindful
The people of Lot ˹also˺ rejected the warnings
We unleashed upon them a storm of stones.
As for ˹the believers of˺ Lot’s family, We delivered them before dawn
as a blessing from Us.
This is how We reward whoever gives thanks
He had already warned them of Our ˹crushing˺ blow but they disputed the warnings
And they even demanded his angel-guests from him,
so We blinded their eyes. ˹And they were told,˺ “Taste then My punishment and warnings!”
And indeed, by the early morning they were overwhelmed by an unrelenting torment
phrases.head: The explanation of the words of the Exalted: "And there overtook them in the early morning an abiding chastisement" (54:38)

phrases.text: ˹Again they were told,˺ “Taste now My punishment and warnings!”
And We have certainly made the Quran easy to remember.
So is there anyone who will be mindful
And indeed, the warnings ˹also˺ came to the people of Pharaoh
phrases.head: The explanation of the statement of the Exalted: وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ آلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُ "And indeed there came to the people of Pharaoh the warnings" (54:41)

phrases.text: ˹But˺ they rejected all of Our signs,
so We seized them with the ˹crushing˺ grip of the Almighty, Most Powerful
Now, are you ˹Meccan˺ disbelievers superior to those ˹destroyed peoples˺?
phrases.head: The explanation of the saying of the Exalted: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أُولَئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِ "Are your disbelievers better than those, or do you have an exemption in the scriptures?" (54:43)

phrases.text: Or have you ˹been granted˺ immunity ˹from punishment˺ in divine Books
Or do they say, “We are all ˹a˺ united ˹front˺, bound to prevail.”
˹Soon˺ their united front will be defeated and ˹forced to˺ flee
Better yet, the Hour is their appointed time
and the Hour will be most catastrophic and most bitter
Indeed, the wicked are ˹entrenched˺ in misguidance,
and ˹are bound for˺ blazes
On the Day they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, ˹they will be told,˺ “Taste the touch of Hell!”
Indeed, We have created everything, perfectly preordained
Our command is but a single word, done in the blink of an eye
phrases.ar: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ
phrases.head: The explanation of His statement, the Exalted: وَمَا أَمْرُنَا إِلا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ بِالْبَصَرِ ("And Our command is but a single [word], like the twinkling of an eye") (54:50).

phrases.text: We have already destroyed the likes of you.
So will any ˹of you˺ be mindful
Everything they have done is ˹listed˺ in ˹their˺ records
Every matter, small and large, is written ˹precisely˺
phrases.head: The explanation of His statement, the Exalted: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُسْتَطَرٌ ("And everything small and great is recorded") (53)

phrases.text: Indeed, the righteous will be amid Gardens and rivers
at the Seat of Honour in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign
